description: FEAT A — the single unified MarketDataService (service->Redis->Postgres->yfinance, .BO/.NS resolution, exclusive-end window normalization, byte-faithful float frames), the PriceBar model, Alembic revision 002 creating ALL THREE Step-2 tables + pgvector, the shared sync engine in database.py, dependency merge + packages.find switch, and the single DataFetcher seam that routes quant AND deep through the service (Gate G2 core). Design §3.4, §3.5, §4, §5. Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: Read docs/designs/step-2-data-unification.md §3.4, §3.5, §4 (all sub-sections incl. §4.4c/§4.4a/§4.4b/§4.5/§4.6), §5 (all) and context.json FIRST.

requirements.txt (§3.4): keep the slice's exact pins for every overlapping name (fastapi, uvicorn, pydantic, pydantic-settings, httpx==0.27.*, pytest, pytest-asyncio — DO NOT re-add or change httpx). Add Tracker-only deps pinned: sqlalchemy==2.0.*, alembic==1.13.*, asyncpg==0.29.*, psycopg2-binary==2.9.*, celery==5.3.*, redis==5.0.*, pytrends==4.9.*, bsedata==1.0.*, pytz==2024.*. Add email-validator/python-jose[cryptography]/passlib[bcrypt]/reportlab ONLY after grep-confirming each is imported by a module reachable from backend.app.main (per §3.4 implementer gate); defer any that is not reachable. Add feedparser==6.0.* (new, used by FEAT-003) and test-only hypothesis==6.*, factory-boy==3.3.*. Resolve exact patch pins against the venv at install time; the invariant is: no overlapping name changes a slice pin and every relocated import resolves.

pyproject.toml (§3.5): replace `[tool.setuptools] packages = [...]` with `[tool.setuptools.packages.find]` where=["."], include=["backend*","quant*","deep*","gateway*"], exclude=["third_party*","frontend*","tests*"]. Then re-run the editable install.

database.py (§7.2/A2): add a shared SYNC engine + session factory alongside the existing async engine — lift SRC-T tasks/insight_calculator._get_sync_database_url (asyncpg->psycopg2 swap) + _create_sync_session (create_engine + sessionmaker(expire_on_commit=False), pool_pre_ping=True). Add a `database_url_sync` (and the FEAT-B news settings placeholders NEWS_RSS_FEEDS/NEWS_BSE_ANNOUNCEMENTS_ENABLED) to backend/app/config.py Settings.

backend/app/models/price_bar.py (§5.1): PriceBar on Base — id BigInteger PK autoincrement; ticker String(32); interval String(8); ts DateTime(timezone=False); open/high/low/close Float(precision=53) (DOUBLE PRECISION); volume BigInteger default 0; source String(16) default 'yfinance'; fetched_at DateTime(timezone=True) server_default now(); __table_args__ UniqueConstraint('ticker','interval','ts', name='uq_price_bars_tkr_interval_ts') + Index('idx_price_bars_lookup','ticker','interval','ts').

ALSO create the model classes backend/app/models/news_item.py (§6.2) and backend/app/models/data_snapshot.py (§7.1) now, so revision 002 can import them and FEAT-003 only adds repositories/services. NewsItem: id BigInt PK, ticker String(32) nullable, source String(64), headline Text, url Text, published_at DateTime(tz) nullable, fetched_at DateTime(tz) server_default now(), dedup_hash String(64); __table_args__ UniqueConstraint('dedup_hash', name='uq_news_items_dedup') + Index('idx_news_ticker_published','ticker','published_at'). DataSnapshot: snapshot_id String(16) PK, ticker String(32), as_of Date, created_at DateTime(tz) server_default now(), payload JSONB (from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql); __table_args__ Index('idx_snapshots_ticker_asof','ticker','as_of'). Register all three in backend/app/models/__init__.py so `import backend.app.models` pulls them into Base.metadata.

Alembic revision 002 (§5.2, decision A10): one file under backend/alembic/versions/ with revision='002', down_revision='001'. upgrade() FIRST runs op.execute("CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector"), then creates price_bars, news_items, data_snapshots exactly per the column specs above (use sa.Float(precision=53) for OHLCV; server_default sa.text("0") for volume, sa.text("'yfinance'") for source; JSONB via postgresql.JSONB). downgrade() drops the three tables + their indexes.

backend/app/services/ticker_resolution.py (§4.3): resolve_market_ticker(ticker, asset_class='stock') — upper/strip, if stock and not endswith (.BO/.NS) default-append .BO, else delegate to quant.config.Config.resolve_ticker for forex/commodity/stock passthrough. Idempotent.

backend/app/repositories/price_bar_repository.py (§5.3): async upsert via sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql.insert(...).on_conflict_do_update(index_elements=['ticker','interval','ts'], set_={open,high,low,close,volume,source,fetched_at=now()}); async point-in-time read with predicate ts>=start AND ts<end (EXCLUSIVE end); a stored-row-count helper for the coverage decision. Provide sync variants (via the sync session) for the sync facade.

backend/app/cache.py (§4.5): add PREFIX_OHLCV='ohlcv:', OHLCV_INTRADAY_TTL=300, OHLCV_DAILY_TTL=86400, and OHLCV serialize/deserialize helpers that cast np.float64->python float (lossless) before json.dumps so the round-trip is bit-identical (NO round()). Key shape ohlcv:{resolved_symbol}:{interval}:{start_norm_iso}:{end_norm_iso}.

backend/app/services/data_service.py (§4.2, §4.4, §4.7, §4.8): MarketDataService async class. get_ohlcv(ticker, interval, start=None, end=None, lookback_days=None, asset_class='stock') -> pd.DataFrame. Step 0: resolve symbol, then §4.4c normalization (end=today if None; clamp intraday lookback to Config.INTRADAY_MAX_LOOKBACK_DAYS; start=end-(lookback_days or Config.DEFAULT_LOOKBACK_DAYS) if None; end EXCLUSIVE) — mirror DataFetcher clamp order EXACTLY. Read path: Redis GET (short-circuit) -> Postgres SELECT with two-regime coverage (§4.4a: historical end<today-FRESH_WINDOW_DAYS[=2] with >=1 row is DB-authoritative no-refetch; recent uses expected-row-count * DB_COVERAGE_MIN_RATIO[=0.90]) -> yfinance leg reproducing DataFetcher's period-vs-start/end branch byte-for-byte (intraday history(period=f'{lookback_days}d', interval=); daily history(start=start_norm, end=end_norm, interval=)), keep only [Open,High,Low,Close,Volume], tz_localize(None), index.name='Datetime'. Build DB/Redis frames as float64 so they are byte-faithful (§4.4b). Upsert on cold fetch; warm Redis. Add DataServiceError. Validate inputs per §4.8. Add a synchronous facade get_ohlcv_sync(...) (same signature) using the sync session + a sync redis client (or asyncio bridge) for the quant/deep callers. FRESH_WINDOW_DAYS and DB_COVERAGE_MIN_RATIO are named module/class constants.

Re-point the G2 seam (§4.6): in quant/data/fetcher.py change ONLY the body of DataFetcher.fetch_historical to call MarketDataService.get_ohlcv_sync(ticker=self.display_ticker, interval=interval, start/end/lookback_days as received, asset_class=self.asset_class) instead of yf.Ticker(...).history(...). Keep the EXACT signature (start_date,end_date,lookback_days,interval) and the EXACT return contract (OHLCV-only float64, tz-naive Datetime-named index). Leave fetch_latest UNCHANGED (still yfinance). Do NOT touch DataPipeline, TechnicalIndicators, or the dropna.

Add a no-infra unit test (§9.4) tests/test_data_service_unit.py: ticker resolution idempotency; dedup-hash function placeholder deferred to FEAT-003; window-normalization + key-parity (get_ohlcv(symbol,'1d',end=D,lookback_days=200) and get_ohlcv(symbol,'1d',start=D-200d,end=D) derive the SAME normalized (start,end), SAME Redis key, SAME daily history(start=,end=,interval='1d') call shape with EXCLUSIVE end; an intraday case asserting the 60-day clamp + history(period='60d',...) shape) using a spied/stubbed yfinance + stubbed repo; the two-regime coverage decision with a stubbed repo (historical short-circuit vs recent-ratio refetch); the sync-facade wrapper over a stubbed async core.
acceptance_criteria: `c:\GIT\Fintech\repo\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r requirements.txt && ... -m pip install -e . && ... -c "import backend.app.main; print('ok')"` succeeds (FEAT-001 relocation now fully imports).
No overlapping dependency name changed a slice pin (httpx stays ==0.27.*, pandas==2.2.2, numpy==1.26.4, etc.).

`... -m alembic -c backend/alembic.ini upgrade head` (stack up) creates price_bars + news_items + data_snapshots and enables the `vector` extension; `... -m alembic -c backend/alembic.ini downgrade -1` then `upgrade head` round-trips cleanly.

quant.recommend and deep.analyze still produce the SAME snapshot_id on the offline synthetic frame (DataFetcher re-point did not perturb the enriched frame); the pre-existing offline suite stays green.
The new no-infra unit test passes: normalized (start,end), Redis key, and daily yfinance call shape are identical across the end+lookback and explicit-start forms, with EXCLUSIVE end.
verification: OFFLINE: `c:\GIT\Fintech\repo\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -q` — pre-existing tests + tests/test_data_service_unit.py pass, no infra required.

INTEGRATION (stack up via docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d — compose is delivered in FEAT-003; until then bring up Postgres+Redis any available way, or defer the integration assertions to FEAT-004 where the stack is guaranteed): run migrations from repo root, then a smoke that get_ohlcv('RELIANCE.BO','1d',lookback_days=200) lands >=60 rows in price_bars and a second call hits cache/DB without re-fetching. findings:

SEAM DETAILS (G2 core):
- backend/app/services/ticker_resolution.py: resolve_market_ticker(ticker, asset_class='stock') — upper/strip, bare stock (not .BO/.NS) => append .BO, else delegate to quant.config.Config.resolve_ticker. Idempotent (unit-proven). Raises ValueError on empty.
- backend/app/services/data_service.py: MarketDataService. Module/class constants FRESH_WINDOW_DAYS=2, DB_COVERAGE_MIN_RATIO=0.90. DataServiceError defined here. get_ohlcv (async) + get_ohlcv_sync (sync facade, SAME signature) -> pd.DataFrame. _normalize_window (staticmethod) mirrors DataFetcher clamp order EXACTLY: clamp lookback (intraday->60) -> default end=today -> start=end-(lookback or DEFAULT_LOOKBACK_DAYS=120). end is EXCLUSIVE everywhere. _redis_key -> ohlcv:{symbol}:{interval}:{start_iso}:{end_iso}. Read path: Redis GET (non-critical, bypass on failure) -> count_bars coverage (_db_is_authoritative: historical end<today-FRESH_WINDOW_DAYS with >=1 row short-circuits no-refetch; recent uses business-day expected*0.90 ratio) -> yfinance leg (_fetch_yfinance) reproducing DataFetcher branch byte-for-byte (intraday history(period=f'{lb}d',interval=); daily history(start=,end=,interval=) EXCLUSIVE end), keep [Open,High,Low,Close,Volume], tz_localize(None), index.name='Datetime', astype float64. Upsert on cold fetch (non-fatal on failure), warm Redis.
- backend/app/repositories/price_bar_repository.py: PriceBarRepository (async) + SyncPriceBarRepository (sync). upsert_bars via pg_insert(...).on_conflict_do_update(index_elements=['ticker','interval','ts'], set_=OHLCV+volume+source+fetched_at=now()); read_bars + count_bars with ts>=start AND ts<end (EXCLUSIVE end), ordered by ts.
- backend/app/cache.py: added PREFIX_OHLCV='ohlcv:', OHLCV_INTRADAY_TTL=300, OHLCV_DAILY_TTL=86400, and serialize_ohlcv/deserialize_ohlcv (np.float64->python float before json.dumps, NO round(); byte-faithful round-trip verified bit-identical).
- backend/app/database.py: added shared SYNC engine (lazy): get_sync_database_url (asyncpg->psycopg2 swap, honors settings.database_url_sync), get_sync_engine/get_sync_session_factory (sessionmaker expire_on_commit=False, pool_pre_ping=True), create_sync_session(). Async engine untouched.
- backend/app/config.py: added database_url_sync (str|None default None), news_rss_feeds (list[str] default []), news_bse_announcements_enabled (bool default False) placeholders for FEAT-B.
- G2 SEAM: quant/data/fetcher.py DataFetcher.fetch_historical body re-pointed to MarketDataService().get_ohlcv_sync(ticker=self.display_ticker, interval=interval, start/end as date objs from the ISO strings, lookback_days, asset_class=self.asset_class). EXACT signature/return contract preserved (service does the OHLCV-only float64 tz-naive Datetime-index post-processing). fetch_latest LEFT ON yfinance (untouched). Removed now-unused top imports (datetime, timedelta, numpy) from fetcher.py; pd/yf/Config retained. DataPipeline, TechnicalIndicators, and the dropna are BYTE-UNCHANGED. The service imports quant.config at module load; quant/data/fetcher.py imports the service LAZILY inside fetch_historical (no circular import at module load).
